h1.en: Just Lost Your Job in Arkansas? Here Are Your 2026 Health Insurance Options
h1.es: Acaba de Perder Su Trabajo en Arkansas? Estas Son Sus Opciones de Seguro Medico 2026

subhero.en: You have 60 days from your last day of Arkansas employer coverage to enroll in a new plan. Arkansas expanded Medicaid through ARHOME, so many laid-off workers qualify for free coverage immediately.
subhero.es: Tiene 60 dias desde su ultimo dia de cobertura del empleador en Arkansas para inscribirse en un nuevo plan. Arkansas expandio Medicaid a traves de ARHOME, por lo que muchos trabajadores despedidos califican para cobertura gratuita de inmediato.

heading.en: You have 60 days from your Arkansas coverage loss date
heading.es: Tiene 60 dias desde la fecha de perdida de cobertura en Arkansas

body.en: Your 60-day loss-of-coverage Special Enrollment Period starts the day after your Arkansas employer coverage ends. For example, if your last day of coverage is July 31, 2026, your SEP window runs August 1 through September 29, 2026. Miss that window and you typically wait until the next ACA Open Enrollment Period starting November 1, 2026, for 2027 coverage. ARHOME (Arkansas Medicaid) has no deadline and is available year-round if your projected 2026 income falls under 138% FPL.
body.es: Su Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias por perdida de cobertura comienza el dia despues de que termina su cobertura del empleador en Arkansas. Por ejemplo, si su ultimo dia de cobertura es el 31 de julio de 2026, su ventana SEP corre del 1 de agosto al 29 de septiembre de 2026. Si pierde esa ventana, tipicamente espera hasta la proxima Inscripcion Abierta del ACA que comienza el 1 de noviembre de 2026 para cobertura de 2027. ARHOME (Medicaid de Arkansas) no tiene fecha limite y esta disponible todo el ano si su ingreso proyectado de 2026 cae bajo el 138% FPL.

label.es: ARHOME / Medicaid de Arkansas (si el ingreso califica)

quickAnswer.en: Losing job-based coverage in Arkansas triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period (SEP). Arkansas expanded Medicaid under ARHOME, so your three main paths are: (1) ARHOME (Arkansas Medicaid) if your projected 2026 income falls under 138% FPL, about $22,025 for a single person or $45,540 for a family of four, which is free year-round coverage; (2) ACA Marketplace plan at healthcare.gov with premium tax credits, typically $10 to $300 per month after subsidies for moderate-income applicants in 2026; and (3) COBRA continuation at 102% of the full premium, typically $500 to $2,000 per month. Most Arkansas residents who lose a job also see enough of an income drop to qualify for ARHOME or large Marketplace subsidies, making COBRA rarely the right choice.
quickAnswer.es: Perder la cobertura del trabajo en Arkansas activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) de 60 dias. Arkansas expandio Medicaid bajo ARHOME, por lo que sus tres caminos principales son: (1) ARHOME (Medicaid de Arkansas) si su ingreso proyectado de 2026 cae bajo el 138% FPL, alrededor de $22,025 para una persona o $45,540 para una familia de cuatro, que es cobertura gratuita todo el ano; (2) plan del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov con creditos fiscales de prima, tipicamente $10 a $300 al mes despues de subsidios; y (3) continuacion COBRA al 102% de la prima completa, tipicamente $500 a $2,000 al mes. La mayoria de residentes de Arkansas que pierden un trabajo ven suficiente caida de ingresos para calificar para ARHOME o grandes subsidios del Mercado.

introParagraphs.en: Losing a job in Arkansas is stressful enough. Losing your health insurance at the same moment transforms that stress into a genuine medical-financial emergency, particularly if you or a family member has ongoing prescriptions, specialist appointments, or a chronic condition. Arkansas built a specific safety valve for this moment: the loss-of-coverage Special Enrollment Period (SEP). Under federal HIPAA Section 9831 rules, any involuntary loss of minimum essential coverage from an employer-sponsored plan is a qualifying life event (QLE) that opens a 60-day window to enroll in new coverage. Arkansas also benefits from ACA Medicaid expansion through ARHOME (Arkansas Health and Opportunity for Me), meaning many laid-off Arkansas workers qualify immediately for free Medicaid coverage rather than paying Marketplace premiums. The 2026 ACA Marketplace Open Enrollment Period ended January 15, 2026. Without a SEP, your only path to subsidized Marketplace coverage is waiting until the 2027 OEP starting November 1, 2026. Acting within 60 days is not optional if you need affordable coverage now.
introParagraphs.es: Perder un trabajo en Arkansas es suficientemente estresante. Perder su seguro medico al mismo tiempo transforma ese estres en una emergencia medico-financiera genuina, especialmente si usted o un familiar tiene recetas continuas, citas con especialistas o una condicion cronica. Arkansas construyo una valvula de seguridad especifica para este momento: el Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) por perdida de cobertura. Bajo las reglas federales de la Seccion 9831 de HIPAA, cualquier perdida involuntaria de cobertura esencial minima de un plan patrocinado por el empleador es un evento calificador de vida (QLE) que abre una ventana de 60 dias para inscribirse en nueva cobertura. Arkansas tambien se beneficia de la expansion de Medicaid del ACA a traves de ARHOME (Arkansas Health and Opportunity for Me), lo que significa que muchos trabajadores despedidos de Arkansas califican de inmediato para cobertura Medicaid gratuita en lugar de pagar primas del Mercado. La OEP del Mercado ACA 2026 termino el 15 de enero de 2026. Sin un SEP, su unico camino hacia cobertura subsidiada del Mercado es esperar hasta la OEP 2027 que comienza el 1 de noviembre de 2026. Actuar dentro de los 60 dias no es opcional si necesita cobertura asequible ahora.

introParagraphs.en: Arkansas expanded Medicaid under the ACA and administers it through ARHOME, the Arkansas Health and Opportunity for Me program. ARHOME covers adults aged 19 to 64 whose household income falls at or below 138% of the Federal Poverty Level. For 2026, that threshold is $22,025 for a single person and $45,540 for a family of four. ARHOME enrollment is open year-round through the Arkansas Department of Human Services at access.arkansas.gov or by calling 1-855-372-1084. Applying at healthcare.gov simultaneously screens for ARHOME and ACA Marketplace plans, so one application covers both pathways. For Arkansas workers with projected 2026 income between 138% FPL and 400% FPL ($63,840 single, $132,000 family of four), ACA Marketplace plans with premium tax credits are the primary option. The 400% FPL subsidy cliff returned for 2026 after enhanced premium tax credits from the American Rescue Plan Act and Inflation Reduction Act expired January 1, 2026. Households above 400% FPL receive no subsidy in 2026. CHIP (ARKids First in Arkansas) covers children at higher income levels and is also year-round.
introParagraphs.es: Arkansas expandio Medicaid bajo el ACA y lo administra a traves de ARHOME, el programa Arkansas Health and Opportunity for Me. ARHOME cubre adultos de 19 a 64 anos cuyo ingreso del hogar cae en o por debajo del 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza. Para 2026, ese umbral es $22,025 para una persona y $45,540 para una familia de cuatro. La inscripcion en ARHOME es abierta todo el ano a traves del Departamento de Servicios Humanos de Arkansas en access.arkansas.gov o llamando al 1-855-372-1084. Aplicar en healthcare.gov simultaneamente evalua ARHOME y los planes del Mercado ACA, por lo que una solicitud cubre ambos caminos. Para los trabajadores de Arkansas con ingreso proyectado de 2026 entre el 138% FPL y el 400% FPL ($63,840 individual, $132,000 familia de cuatro), los planes del Mercado ACA con creditos fiscales de prima son la opcion principal. El precipicio de subsidio del 400% FPL regreso para 2026 despues de que los creditos fiscales de prima mejorados de la Ley del Plan de Rescate Americano y la Ley de Reduccion de Inflacion expiraron el 1 de enero de 2026. Los hogares por encima del 400% FPL no reciben subsidio en 2026. CHIP (ARKids First en Arkansas) cubre a ninos en niveles de ingresos mas altos y tambien es todo el ano.

name.en: Confirm your last day of Arkansas employer coverage
name.es: Confirme su ultimo dia de cobertura del empleador en Arkansas

text.en: Call your HR department or check your termination letter to get the exact date your employer health coverage ends. Most Arkansas employer plans end on the last day of the month you were terminated, but some end on the actual termination date. This date starts your 60-day SEP clock. Request a HIPAA certificate of creditable coverage in writing from your former employer's HR department, because you will need it as documentation when submitting your SEP application at healthcare.gov.
text.es: Llame a su departamento de recursos humanos o revise su carta de terminacion para obtener la fecha exacta en que termina su cobertura del empleador. La mayoria de planes del empleador en Arkansas terminan el ultimo dia del mes en que fue despedido. Esta fecha inicia su reloj SEP de 60 dias. Solicite un certificado de cobertura acreditable de HIPAA por escrito a su antiguo empleador, ya que lo necesitara como documentacion al enviar su solicitud SEP en healthcare.gov.

name.en: Calculate your projected 2026 household income for Arkansas
name.es: Calcule su ingreso proyectado del hogar de 2026 para Arkansas

text.en: Use only what you expect to earn for the rest of 2026, not your previous annual salary. Include Arkansas unemployment compensation in your income projection, as unemployment benefits count as Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) under IRS rules. If your projected 2026 income for a household of one falls under $22,025, or under $45,540 for a family of four, apply for ARHOME (Arkansas Medicaid) first. Projected income between 138% FPL and 400% FPL qualifies for ACA Marketplace premium tax credits at healthcare.gov.
text.es: Use solo lo que espera ganar el resto de 2026, no su salario anual anterior. Incluya la compensacion por desempleo de Arkansas en su proyeccion de ingresos, ya que los beneficios de desempleo cuentan como Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) bajo las reglas del IRS. Si su ingreso proyectado de 2026 para un hogar de una persona cae bajo $22,025, o bajo $45,540 para una familia de cuatro, solicite primero ARHOME (Medicaid de Arkansas). El ingreso proyectado entre el 138% FPL y el 400% FPL califica para creditos fiscales de prima del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov.

name.en: Apply for ARHOME (Arkansas Medicaid) if income qualifies
name.es: Solicite ARHOME (Medicaid de Arkansas) si el ingreso califica

text.en: Apply at access.arkansas.gov or at healthcare.gov, which routes to ARHOME automatically if your income qualifies. ARHOME covers Arkansas adults aged 19 to 64 at or below 138% FPL and is free with no monthly premium. Call 1-855-372-1084 to apply by phone or visit a local Arkansas Department of Human Services office. ARHOME enrollment is year-round with no 60-day deadline, so even if you miss the Marketplace SEP window, ARHOME remains available if your income qualifies.
text.es: Solicite en access.arkansas.gov o en healthcare.gov, que lo dirige automaticamente a ARHOME si su ingreso califica. ARHOME cubre adultos de Arkansas de 19 a 64 anos en o por debajo del 138% FPL y es gratuito sin prima mensual. Llame al 1-855-372-1084 para solicitar por telefono o visite una oficina local del Departamento de Servicios Humanos de Arkansas. La inscripcion en ARHOME es todo el ano sin fecha limite de 60 dias, por lo que incluso si pierde la ventana SEP del Mercado, ARHOME permanece disponible si su ingreso califica.

name.en: Apply for ACA Marketplace SEP at healthcare.gov within 60 days
name.es: Solicite el SEP del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov dentro de 60 dias

text.en: Log in to healthcare.gov and select 'Report a life event' then 'Lost health insurance through a job.' Arkansas uses the federal healthcare.gov exchange, not a state-run portal. Upload your termination letter or HIPAA certificate as documentation. Compare Silver and Gold plan options for your Arkansas ZIP code. In 2026, premium tax credits reduce most Silver plans to $10 to $300 per month for moderate-income applicants. Arkansas counties have varying plan options depending on insurer participation in each service area.
text.es: Inicie sesion en healthcare.gov y seleccione 'Reportar un evento de vida' luego 'Perdi el seguro medico a traves de un trabajo.' Arkansas usa el intercambio federal healthcare.gov, no un portal estatal. Cargue su carta de terminacion o certificado HIPAA como documentacion. Compare opciones de planes Silver y Gold para su codigo postal de Arkansas. En 2026, los creditos fiscales de prima reducen la mayoria de planes Silver a $10 a $300 al mes para solicitantes de ingresos moderados. Los condados de Arkansas tienen opciones de planes variables dependiendo de la participacion de los aseguradores.

name.en: Check whether your spouse's employer plan is an option
name.es: Verifique si el plan del empleador de su conyuge es una opcion

text.en: Your Arkansas job loss is also a qualifying life event for your spouse's employer plan, giving you 30 days to enroll under your spouse's coverage. Call your spouse's HR department immediately, because this 30-day employer-plan window is separate from and shorter than the 60-day Marketplace SEP. Your spouse's employer plan is often the most cost-effective option if the employer subsidizes premiums and the plan network includes your current Arkansas providers.
text.es: La perdida de su trabajo en Arkansas es tambien un evento calificador de vida para el plan del empleador de su conyuge, dandole 30 dias para inscribirse bajo la cobertura de su conyuge. Llame inmediatamente al departamento de recursos humanos de su conyuge, porque esta ventana de 30 dias del plan del empleador es separada y mas corta que el SEP del Mercado de 60 dias. El plan del empleador de su conyuge es a menudo la opcion mas rentable si el empleador subsidia las primas y la red del plan incluye sus proveedores actuales de Arkansas.

name.en: Check ARKids First for your children's coverage
name.es: Verifique ARKids First para la cobertura de sus hijos

text.en: ARKids First is Arkansas's CHIP program and covers children up to age 19 in households with income up to 211% FPL (about $69,630 for a family of four in 2026). ARKids First enrollment is year-round with no deadline, and premiums are very low or free depending on household income. Apply at access.arkansas.gov or through healthcare.gov. Even if your income is above ARHOME limits for adults, your children may still qualify for ARKids First independently.
text.es: ARKids First es el programa CHIP de Arkansas y cubre a ninos hasta los 19 anos en hogares con ingresos de hasta el 211% FPL (alrededor de $50,791 para una familia de cuatro en 2026). La inscripcion en ARKids First es todo el ano sin fecha limite, y las primas son muy bajas o gratuitas dependiendo del ingreso del hogar. Solicite en access.arkansas.gov o a traves de healthcare.gov. Incluso si sus ingresos estan por encima de los limites de ARHOME para adultos, sus hijos pueden aun calificar para ARKids First de forma independiente.

name.en: Evaluate COBRA only after comparing all other Arkansas options
name.es: Evalue COBRA solo despues de comparar todas las otras opciones en Arkansas

text.en: COBRA charges 102% of the full group premium (employer share plus employee share plus 2% administrative fee). For a single Arkansas employee, that is typically $500 to $900 per month; for a family, $1,200 to $2,800 per month in 2026. Elect COBRA only if you have ongoing specialist treatment not covered by any ARHOME or Marketplace network in your Arkansas county, or if your 2026 deductible is already substantially met and you need to preserve your current plan through year-end. You have 60 days to elect COBRA retroactively, so you can compare all other options first without losing COBRA access.
text.es: COBRA cobra el 102% de la prima grupal completa (parte del empleador mas la del empleado mas el 2% de tarifa administrativa). Para un empleado individual de Arkansas, eso es tipicamente $500 a $900 al mes; para una familia, $1,200 a $2,800 al mes en 2026. Elija COBRA solo si tiene tratamiento especializado continuo no cubierto por ningun red de ARHOME o del Mercado en su condado de Arkansas, o si su deducible de 2026 ya esta sustancialmente cumplido. Tiene 60 dias para elegir COBRA retroactivamente, por lo que puede comparar todas las demas opciones primero sin perder el acceso a COBRA.

intro.en: The costliest mistakes Arkansas residents make after losing job-based coverage in 2026:
intro.es: Los errores mas costosos que los residentes de Arkansas cometen despues de perder cobertura del trabajo en 2026:

items.en: Defaulting to COBRA without checking ARHOME first. Arkansas expanded Medicaid through ARHOME, so many laid-off workers qualify for free coverage immediately. Paying $500 to $900 per month in COBRA premiums when ARHOME is available at no cost is a preventable expense.
items.es: Optar automaticamente por COBRA sin verificar ARHOME primero. Arkansas expandio Medicaid a traves de ARHOME, por lo que muchos trabajadores despedidos califican para cobertura gratuita de inmediato. Pagar $500 a $900 al mes en primas COBRA cuando ARHOME esta disponible sin costo es un gasto evitable.

items.en: Reporting your old annual salary instead of projected 2026 income. The Marketplace and ARHOME calculate eligibility on Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) for the rest of the current year. A lower projected income means larger ACA premium tax credits or ARHOME eligibility you would otherwise miss.
items.es: Reportar su salario anual anterior en lugar del ingreso proyectado de 2026. El Mercado y ARHOME calculan la elegibilidad sobre el Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) para el resto del ano actual. Un ingreso proyectado mas bajo significa creditos fiscales de prima ACA mas grandes o elegibilidad ARHOME que de otro modo perderia.

items.en: Forgetting to include Arkansas unemployment compensation in your income projection. Arkansas unemployment benefits count as MAGI for ACA subsidy purposes. Include your weekly benefit times the number of weeks expected in your 2026 income projection when applying at healthcare.gov.
items.es: Olvidar incluir la compensacion por desempleo de Arkansas en su proyeccion de ingresos. Los beneficios de desempleo de Arkansas cuentan como MAGI para propositos de subsidio ACA. Incluya su beneficio semanal por el numero de semanas esperadas en su proyeccion de ingresos de 2026 al solicitar en healthcare.gov.

items.en: Missing the 60-day Marketplace SEP window. Without active SEP documentation, healthcare.gov rejects a Marketplace application submitted after Day 60. ARHOME remains open year-round, but ACA Marketplace subsidized plans are only available during the SEP or the 2027 OEP starting November 1, 2026.
items.es: Perder la ventana SEP del Mercado de 60 dias. Sin documentacion SEP activa, healthcare.gov rechaza una solicitud del Mercado enviada despues del dia 60. ARHOME permanece abierto todo el ano, pero los planes subsidiados del Mercado ACA solo estan disponibles durante el SEP o la OEP 2027 que comienza el 1 de noviembre de 2026.

items.en: Assuming children are covered automatically under COBRA without electing it. Each family member must be separately included in a COBRA election form. Arkansas children may qualify for ARKids First at far lower cost than COBRA, and ARKids First enrollment is year-round.
items.es: Asumir que los hijos estan cubiertos automaticamente bajo COBRA sin elegirlo. Cada miembro de la familia debe ser incluido separadamente en un formulario de eleccion COBRA. Los ninos de Arkansas pueden calificar para ARKids First a un costo mucho menor que COBRA, y la inscripcion en ARKids First es todo el ano.

items.en: Not uploading proof of the qualifying life event when submitting the SEP application at healthcare.gov. Missing or delayed documentation causes the application to pend without approval, and the 60-day clock continues running while you wait.
items.es: No cargar prueba del evento calificador de vida al enviar la solicitud SEP en healthcare.gov. La documentacion faltante o retrasada hace que la solicitud quede pendiente sin aprobacion, y el reloj de 60 dias sigue corriendo mientras espera.

heading.en: COBRA vs ARHOME vs ACA Marketplace: Which Should Arkansas Residents Choose in 2026?
heading.es: COBRA vs ARHOME vs Mercado ACA: Que Deben Elegir los Residentes de Arkansas en 2026?

body.en: After losing job-based coverage in Arkansas in 2026, three major pathways open. COBRA preserves your old plan at 102% of the full premium, typically $500 to $900 per month for an individual and $1,200 to $2,800 per month for family coverage, making it the most expensive option in almost every Arkansas scenario. ARHOME (Arkansas Medicaid) is free for adults aged 19 to 64 whose projected 2026 income falls at or below 138% FPL, which is $22,025 for a single person and $45,540 for a family of four. ARHOME covers doctor visits, hospital stays, prescription drugs, mental health, and preventive care with no monthly premium. ACA Marketplace plans at healthcare.gov drop most moderate-income Arkansas enrollees to $10 to $300 per month after premium tax credits in 2026, per the KFF Marketplace Premium Analysis, with the trade-off that you may need to change providers if your former employer's network differs from available Arkansas Marketplace plan networks. The decision framework for Arkansas residents is: check ARHOME first (free, year-round, if projected income qualifies under 138% FPL); then check a spouse's employer plan (if available and cheaper than Marketplace); then apply for ACA Marketplace SEP with premium tax credits at healthcare.gov (the most common 2026 path for Arkansas workers earning between 139% and 400% FPL); use COBRA only as a last resort when you have ongoing treatment with a specialist not in any ARHOME or Marketplace network in your Arkansas county, or when your 2026 deductible is already substantially met and you cannot replicate it under a new plan.
body.es: Despues de perder la cobertura del trabajo en Arkansas en 2026, tres caminos principales se abren. COBRA preserva su plan anterior al 102% de la prima completa, tipicamente $500 a $900 al mes para un individuo y $1,200 a $2,800 al mes para cobertura familiar, convirtiendolo en la opcion mas cara en casi todos los escenarios de Arkansas. ARHOME (Medicaid de Arkansas) es gratuito para adultos de 19 a 64 anos cuyo ingreso proyectado de 2026 cae en o por debajo del 138% FPL, que es $22,025 para una persona y $45,540 para una familia de cuatro. ARHOME cubre visitas medicas, hospitalizaciones, medicamentos recetados, salud mental y cuidado preventivo sin prima mensual. Los planes del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov reducen a la mayoria de los inscritos de ingresos moderados en Arkansas a $10 a $300 al mes despues de creditos fiscales de prima en 2026, segun el Analisis de Primas del Mercado de KFF. El marco de decision para los residentes de Arkansas es: verificar ARHOME primero; luego el plan del conyuge; luego solicitar el SEP del Mercado ACA; usar COBRA solo como ultimo recurso.

Talones de pago recientes o carta de beneficio de desempleo de Arkansas para el calculo de ingresos proyectados de 2026
Actas de nacimiento para cualquier nino dependiente que agregue a ARHOME, ARKids First o un nuevo plan del Mercado
Documentos de inmigracion si algun miembro del hogar no es ciudadano estadounidense (tarjeta verde, visa o Documento de Autorizacion de Empleo)

stateRules.rule: ARHOME (Arkansas Health and Opportunity for Me) is Arkansas's expanded Medicaid program covering adults aged 19 to 64 at or below 138% FPL. Arkansas uses healthcare.gov for Marketplace enrollment, not a separate state exchange. Apply for ARHOME at access.arkansas.gov or call 1-855-372-1084. ARKids First covers children up to age 19 at incomes up to approximately 211% FPL.

Arkansas COBRA rules: employers with 20 or more employees are subject to federal COBRA (18 months for most qualifying events). Arkansas does not have a state mini-COBRA law extending continuation coverage to smaller employers, so employees of Arkansas employers with fewer than 20 workers must use the ACA Marketplace SEP or ARHOME after job loss.

ARKids First, Arkansas's CHIP program, covers children under age 19 at incomes up to approximately 211% FPL (roughly $69,630 for a family of four in 2026). ARKids First A covers children in Medicaid-income households; ARKids First B covers children in households between 138% and 211% FPL with a small premium. Enrollment is year-round at access.arkansas.gov.

heading.en: ARHOME Medicaid Eligibility After Losing Your Job in Arkansas in 2026
heading.es: Elegibilidad de ARHOME Medicaid Despues de Perder Su Trabajo en Arkansas en 2026

paragraphs.en: Arkansas expanded Medicaid under the ACA and now operates the program as ARHOME (Arkansas Health and Opportunity for Me). ARHOME covers adults aged 19 to 64 whose household income falls at or below 138% of the Federal Poverty Level. For 2026, that threshold is $22,025 for a single person and $45,540 for a family of four, calculated using the Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) methodology under IRS rules. Job loss often moves workers directly into ARHOME eligibility, because the income calculation uses only projected income for the rest of 2026, not the annualized salary you earned before the layoff. A worker who earned $50,000 from January through June and then lost their job may project only $25,000 for the full year, potentially putting them just above or below the ARHOME threshold.
paragraphs.es: Arkansas expandio Medicaid bajo el ACA y ahora opera el programa como ARHOME (Arkansas Health and Opportunity for Me). ARHOME cubre adultos de 19 a 64 anos cuyo ingreso del hogar cae en o por debajo del 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza. Para 2026, ese umbral es $22,025 para una persona y $45,540 para una familia de cuatro, calculado usando la metodologia del Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) bajo las reglas del IRS. La perdida del trabajo a menudo mueve a los trabajadores directamente a la elegibilidad de ARHOME, porque el calculo de ingresos usa solo el ingreso proyectado para el resto de 2026, no el salario anualizado ganado antes del despido.

paragraphs.en: ARHOME enrollment is open year-round through the Arkansas Department of Human Services at access.arkansas.gov or by calling 1-855-372-1084. Applying at healthcare.gov simultaneously screens for ARHOME eligibility and ACA Marketplace plan options, so a single application covers both pathways. ARHOME benefits include physician visits, hospital inpatient and outpatient care, emergency services, prescription drugs, mental health and substance use disorder services, laboratory and imaging services, and preventive care. There is no monthly premium for ARHOME enrollees. Arkansas Medicaid eligibility is determined within 45 days for most applicants. If you miss the 60-day ACA Marketplace SEP but your income qualifies, ARHOME remains available at any time throughout 2026.
paragraphs.es: La inscripcion en ARHOME es abierta todo el ano a traves del Departamento de Servicios Humanos de Arkansas en access.arkansas.gov o llamando al 1-855-372-1084. Aplicar en healthcare.gov simultaneamente evalua la elegibilidad de ARHOME y las opciones de planes del Mercado ACA, por lo que una sola solicitud cubre ambos caminos. Los beneficios de ARHOME incluyen visitas medicas, atencion hospitalaria ambulatoria y hospitalaria, servicios de emergencia, medicamentos recetados, servicios de salud mental y trastorno por uso de sustancias, servicios de laboratorio e imagenes, y cuidado preventivo. No hay prima mensual para los inscritos en ARHOME.

heading.en: Documents and Proof: What Arkansas Residents Need for the SEP Application
heading.es: Documentos y Pruebas: Lo Que Necesitan los Residentes de Arkansas para la Solicitud SEP

paragraphs.en: Arkansas's SEP application at healthcare.gov requires specific documentation to validate the qualifying life event. Your employer termination letter is the primary proof document, showing the date Arkansas employer coverage ends. A COBRA election notice from your former employer serves the same purpose and is accepted as documentation at healthcare.gov. A HIPAA certificate of creditable coverage (which employers are required to provide under Section 9831 after coverage ends) details the type and duration of prior coverage and is critical if you later need to establish creditable coverage history for a waiting-period waiver at a new Arkansas job. Request all three documents in writing from your former employer's HR department on your last day or within the first week after separation.
paragraphs.es: La solicitud SEP de Arkansas en healthcare.gov requiere documentacion especifica para validar el evento calificador de vida. Su carta de terminacion del empleador es el documento de prueba principal, mostrando la fecha en que termina la cobertura del empleador de Arkansas. Un aviso de eleccion COBRA de su antiguo empleador sirve el mismo proposito y es aceptado como documentacion en healthcare.gov. Un certificado de cobertura acreditable de HIPAA (que los empleadores deben proporcionar bajo la Seccion 9831 despues de que termina la cobertura) detalla el tipo y duracion de la cobertura anterior y es critico si necesita establecer historial de cobertura acreditable para una exencion del periodo de espera en un nuevo trabajo de Arkansas.

paragraphs.en: Income documentation for the Arkansas ACA subsidy calculation follows IRS MAGI rules. Pay stubs from your final weeks of Arkansas employment establish your prior income. Your Arkansas unemployment benefit award letter from the Arkansas Division of Workforce Services (DWS) establishes your going-forward weekly benefit amount, which counts as MAGI income for ACA subsidy purposes. The Marketplace will ask you to project your total 2026 income. If that projection later proves materially wrong, you reconcile at tax time using Form 1095-A. Underestimating income leads to a tax-time repayment of excess advance premium tax credits. Overestimating leads to a refund. Arkansas DWS provides benefit award documentation at dws.arkansas.gov or by calling 1-855-225-4440.
paragraphs.es: La documentacion de ingresos para el calculo del subsidio ACA de Arkansas sigue las reglas MAGI del IRS. Los talones de pago de sus ultimas semanas de empleo en Arkansas establecen sus ingresos anteriores. Su carta de beneficio de desempleo de Arkansas de la Division de Servicios a la Fuerza Laboral (DWS) de Arkansas establece su monto de beneficio semanal en curso, que cuenta como ingreso MAGI para propositos de subsidio ACA. El Mercado le pedira que proyecte sus ingresos totales de 2026. Arkansas DWS proporciona documentacion de beneficios en dws.arkansas.gov o llamando al 1-855-225-4440.

heading.en: ARKids First and Children's Coverage After Arkansas Job Loss in 2026
heading.es: ARKids First y Cobertura para Ninos Despues de Perder el Trabajo en Arkansas en 2026

paragraphs.en: ARKids First is Arkansas's Children's Health Insurance Program (CHIP). Arkansas operates ARKids First in two tracks: ARKids First A, which covers children in ARHOME-eligible households at or below 138% FPL at no cost; and ARKids First B, which covers children in households between 138% and approximately 211% FPL ($69,630 for a family of four in 2026) at very low premiums. Both tracks cover children under age 19 with comprehensive benefits including doctor visits, dental care, vision, prescription drugs, hospital care, and mental health services. ARKids First enrollment is year-round with no 60-day deadline, making it available even if you miss the ACA Marketplace SEP. Apply at access.arkansas.gov or through healthcare.gov, which screens for ARKids First eligibility automatically.
paragraphs.es: ARKids First es el Programa de Seguro de Salud para Ninos (CHIP) de Arkansas. Arkansas opera ARKids First en dos niveles: ARKids First A, que cubre a ninos en hogares elegibles para ARHOME en o por debajo del 138% FPL sin costo; y ARKids First B, que cubre a ninos en hogares entre el 138% y aproximadamente el 211% FPL ($69,630 para una familia de cuatro en 2026) a primas muy bajas. Ambos niveles cubren a ninos menores de 19 anos con beneficios integrales. La inscripcion en ARKids First es todo el ano sin fecha limite de 60 dias, lo que la hace disponible incluso si pierde el SEP del Mercado ACA.

paragraphs.en: Losing job-based coverage in Arkansas is a qualifying life event for ARKids First as well as the ACA Marketplace, but because ARKids First is year-round, parents do not face the same 60-day deadline pressure for their children that they do for their own ACA Marketplace coverage. Even Arkansas households with income significantly above ARHOME thresholds for adults can often enroll children in ARKids First B at low cost. For example, a single parent earning $35,000 in 2026 would be above the adult ARHOME limit of $22,025 but well within the ARKids First B range for their children. Contact the Arkansas Department of Human Services at 1-855-372-1084 or visit access.arkansas.gov to apply for both parent and child coverage in one step.
paragraphs.es: Perder la cobertura del trabajo en Arkansas es un evento calificador de vida para ARKids First asi como para el Mercado ACA, pero como ARKids First es todo el ano, los padres no enfrentan la misma presion de fecha limite de 60 dias para sus hijos que para su propia cobertura del Mercado ACA. Incluso los hogares de Arkansas con ingresos significativamente por encima de los umbrales de ARHOME para adultos pueden a menudo inscribir a sus hijos en ARKids First B a bajo costo. Por ejemplo, un padre soltero que gane $35,000 en 2026 estaria por encima del limite adulto de ARHOME de $22,025 pero bien dentro del rango de ARKids First B para sus hijos. Contacte al Departamento de Servicios Humanos de Arkansas al 1-855-372-1084 o visite access.arkansas.gov para solicitar cobertura para padres e hijos en un solo paso.

heading.en: 2026 ACA Subsidy Cliff: How Job Loss Changes Your Arkansas Marketplace Eligibility
heading.es: Precipicio del Subsidio ACA 2026: Como Cambia la Perdida del Trabajo Su Elegibilidad en el Mercado de Arkansas

paragraphs.en: Enhanced premium tax credits from the American Rescue Plan Act and the Inflation Reduction Act expired January 1, 2026. The 400% FPL subsidy cliff returned for 2026 plan year. Arkansas households with projected annual income above 400% FPL ($63,840 for a single person, $132,000 for a family of four) receive no ACA premium tax credit under current 2026 law. For most Arkansas residents who lose a job, the income drop itself moves them well below the 400% FPL cliff, making Marketplace subsidies newly available. An Arkansas worker who earned $70,000 before the layoff and now projects only $30,000 for 2026 would drop from no-subsidy territory into the range where premium tax credits reduce their monthly Marketplace premium to $50 to $200 depending on age, family size, and plan selected.
paragraphs.es: Los creditos fiscales de prima mejorados de la Ley del Plan de Rescate Americano y la Ley de Reduccion de Inflacion expiraron el 1 de enero de 2026. El precipicio de subsidio del 400% FPL regreso para el ano del plan 2026. Los hogares de Arkansas con ingreso anual proyectado por encima del 400% FPL ($63,840 para una persona, $132,000 para una familia de cuatro) no reciben credito fiscal de prima ACA bajo la ley actual de 2026. Para la mayoria de residentes de Arkansas que pierden un trabajo, la propia caida de ingresos los mueve bien por debajo del precipicio del 400% FPL, haciendo los subsidios del Mercado nuevamente disponibles.

paragraphs.en: ACA Marketplace Silver plans with cost-sharing reductions (CSR) are available only to Arkansas households with projected 2026 income between 100% and 250% FPL. CSR plans significantly reduce deductibles, copays, and out-of-pocket maximums. The 2026 ACA Marketplace out-of-pocket maximum is $10,600 for an individual and $21,200 for a family. CSR plans for Arkansas households under 150% FPL can reduce those maximums to $3,000 individual and $6,000 family. Apply through healthcare.gov to access CSR-eligible Silver plans during your 60-day SEP. Arkansas households above 250% FPL can still access premium tax credits on any metal tier plan through the 400% FPL subsidy cliff, but do not receive the enhanced cost-sharing reduction benefit.
paragraphs.es: Los planes Silver del Mercado ACA con reducciones de costos compartidos (CSR) estan disponibles solo para hogares de Arkansas con ingreso proyectado de 2026 entre el 100% y el 250% FPL. Los planes CSR reducen significativamente los deducibles, copagos y maximos de gasto de bolsillo. El maximo de gasto de bolsillo del Mercado ACA 2026 es $10,600 para un individuo y $21,200 para una familia. Los planes CSR para hogares de Arkansas bajo el 150% FPL pueden reducir esos maximos a $3,000 individual y $6,000 familiar. Solicite a traves de healthcare.gov para acceder a planes Silver elegibles para CSR durante su SEP de 60 dias.

en.question: What is the Special Enrollment Period window after losing a job in Arkansas in 2026?
en.answer: Your loss-of-coverage Special Enrollment Period starts the day after your Arkansas employer health coverage ends and runs for 60 consecutive days. For example, if coverage ends July 31, 2026, your SEP window is August 1 through September 29, 2026. Submit your application and select a plan before Day 60 at healthcare.gov. Plans typically take effect on the first of the month following enrollment. ARHOME (Arkansas Medicaid) has no deadline and is available year-round if your projected 2026 income falls under 138% FPL.

en.question: What documents do I need to prove job loss for the Arkansas SEP application?
en.answer: Healthcare.gov accepts your employer termination letter, a COBRA election notice, or a HIPAA certificate of creditable coverage as proof of the qualifying life event. The document must show the date your Arkansas employer coverage ends. Upload the document when you start your SEP application at healthcare.gov. Contact your former employer's HR department on your last day to request the termination letter and HIPAA certificate in writing. If you do not have the document immediately, begin the application and upload it later, but the 60-day clock continues running.

en.question: Do I qualify for ARHOME Medicaid after losing my job in Arkansas?
en.answer: ARHOME covers Arkansas adults aged 19 to 64 whose projected 2026 household income falls at or below 138% of the Federal Poverty Level. For 2026, that is $22,025 for a single person and $45,540 for a family of four. ARHOME is free with no monthly premium and enrollment is open year-round at access.arkansas.gov or through healthcare.gov. The income calculation uses your projected income for the rest of 2026, not your prior annual salary, so many workers who earned above the threshold while employed now qualify after the layoff. Call 1-855-372-1084 to apply by phone.

en.question: Is COBRA worth it after losing a job in Arkansas in 2026?
en.answer: COBRA is rarely the best financial choice for Arkansas residents after job loss. COBRA charges 102% of the full group premium, typically $500 to $900 per month for an individual and $1,200 to $2,800 per month for a family in 2026. Most Arkansas workers who lose a job see enough of an income drop to qualify for either ARHOME (free) or ACA Marketplace plans with subsidies ($10 to $300 per month). Federal COBRA applies to Arkansas employers with 20 or more employees, lasting 18 months for most qualifying events. Arkansas has no state mini-COBRA law for smaller employers. Elect COBRA only if you have ongoing specialist treatment not available in any ARHOME or Marketplace network, or if your 2026 deductible is already substantially met.

en.question: Does Arkansas unemployment income count toward ACA subsidy eligibility?
en.answer: Yes. Arkansas unemployment compensation counts as income for ACA Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) calculations. Include your weekly Arkansas unemployment benefit from the Arkansas Division of Workforce Services multiplied by the number of weeks you expect to receive it in your projected 2026 annual income when applying at healthcare.gov. This matters because the total projected income determines whether you qualify for ARHOME or ACA Marketplace premium tax credits, and whether those credits are calculated correctly. An accurate projection reduces the chance of owing back advance premium tax credits at tax time using Form 1095-A.

en.question: What if I miss the 60-day SEP after job loss in Arkansas?
en.answer: Missing the 60-day loss-of-coverage SEP means you cannot enroll in a subsidized ACA Marketplace plan until the 2027 Open Enrollment Period, which runs November 1 through January 15 for coverage starting January 1, 2027. ARHOME (Arkansas Medicaid) remains open year-round at any time if your income qualifies. ARKids First for children is also available year-round. If another qualifying life event occurs during the gap, such as moving within Arkansas, having a baby, or getting married, that event restarts a new 60-day SEP window.

en.question: What Arkansas-specific rules apply to health insurance after job loss?
en.answer: Arkansas uses healthcare.gov for Marketplace enrollment, not a separate state exchange. ARHOME (Arkansas Medicaid) is administered by the Arkansas Department of Human Services and covers adults at 138% FPL through the ACA expansion. ARKids First covers children up to age 19 at approximately 211% FPL. Arkansas does not have a state mini-COBRA law for employers with fewer than 20 employees, meaning workers at small Arkansas businesses must use ARHOME or the Marketplace SEP. Apply for ARHOME at access.arkansas.gov or call 1-855-372-1084. For Marketplace plans, apply at healthcare.gov and select your Arkansas county to see available plans.

en.question: What happens to my children's coverage after I lose my job in Arkansas?
en.answer: ARKids First (Arkansas CHIP) covers children under age 19 in households up to approximately 211% FPL (about $69,630 for a family of four in 2026). ARKids First A is free for households within ARHOME income limits. ARKids First B covers children in higher-income households at very low premiums. ARKids First enrollment is year-round with no 60-day deadline. Even if your own income is too high for ARHOME after the job loss, your children may still qualify for ARKids First B independently. Apply at access.arkansas.gov or through healthcare.gov, which screens for ARKids First eligibility automatically alongside adult coverage options.

es.question: Cual es la ventana del Periodo de Inscripcion Especial despues de perder un trabajo en Arkansas en 2026?
es.answer: Su Periodo de Inscripcion Especial por perdida de cobertura comienza el dia despues de que termina su cobertura medica del empleador de Arkansas y dura 60 dias consecutivos. Por ejemplo, si la cobertura termina el 31 de julio de 2026, su ventana SEP es del 1 de agosto al 29 de septiembre de 2026. Envie su solicitud y seleccione un plan antes del dia 60 en healthcare.gov. Los planes tipicamente entran en vigor el primero del mes siguiente a su inscripcion. ARHOME (Medicaid de Arkansas) no tiene fecha limite y esta disponible todo el ano si su ingreso proyectado de 2026 cae bajo el 138% FPL.

es.question: Que documentos necesito para probar la perdida del trabajo para la solicitud SEP de Arkansas?
es.answer: Healthcare.gov acepta su carta de terminacion del empleador, un aviso de eleccion COBRA o un certificado de cobertura acreditable de HIPAA como prueba del evento calificador de vida. El documento debe mostrar la fecha en que termina su cobertura del empleador de Arkansas. Cargue el documento cuando comience su solicitud SEP en healthcare.gov. Contacte a recursos humanos de su antiguo empleador el dia de su salida para solicitar la carta de terminacion y el certificado HIPAA por escrito.

es.question: Califico para ARHOME Medicaid despues de perder mi trabajo en Arkansas?
es.answer: ARHOME cubre adultos de Arkansas de 19 a 64 anos cuyo ingreso proyectado del hogar de 2026 cae en o por debajo del 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza. Para 2026, eso es $22,025 para una persona y $45,540 para una familia de cuatro. ARHOME es gratuito sin prima mensual y la inscripcion es abierta todo el ano en access.arkansas.gov o a traves de healthcare.gov. El calculo de ingresos usa su ingreso proyectado para el resto de 2026, no su salario anual anterior, por lo que muchos trabajadores que ganaban por encima del umbral mientras estaban empleados ahora califican despues del despido. Llame al 1-855-372-1084 para solicitar por telefono.

es.question: Vale la pena COBRA despues de perder un trabajo en Arkansas en 2026?
es.answer: COBRA raramente es la mejor opcion financiera para los residentes de Arkansas despues de perder el trabajo. COBRA cobra el 102% de la prima grupal completa, tipicamente $500 a $900 al mes para un individuo y $1,200 a $2,800 al mes para una familia en 2026. La mayoria de trabajadores de Arkansas que pierden un trabajo ven suficiente caida de ingresos para calificar para ARHOME (gratis) o planes del Mercado ACA con subsidios ($10 a $300 al mes). COBRA federal aplica a empleadores de Arkansas con 20 o mas empleados, durando 18 meses para la mayoria de eventos calificadores. Arkansas no tiene ley mini-COBRA estatal para empleadores mas pequenos. Elija COBRA solo si tiene tratamiento especializado continuo no disponible en ninguna red de ARHOME o del Mercado.

es.question: Cuenta el ingreso por desempleo de Arkansas para la elegibilidad de subsidio ACA?
es.answer: Si. La compensacion por desempleo de Arkansas cuenta como ingreso para los calculos del Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) del ACA. Incluya su beneficio semanal de desempleo de Arkansas de la Division de Servicios a la Fuerza Laboral multiplicado por el numero de semanas que espera recibirlo en su ingreso anual proyectado de 2026 al solicitar en healthcare.gov. Una proyeccion precisa reduce la posibilidad de deber creditos fiscales de prima anticipados de vuelta al tiempo de impuestos usando el Formulario 1095-A.

es.question: Que pasa si pierdo el SEP de 60 dias despues de perder el trabajo en Arkansas?
es.answer: Perder el SEP de 60 dias por perdida de cobertura significa que no puede inscribirse en un plan del Mercado ACA subsidiado hasta el Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta 2027, que corre del 1 de noviembre al 15 de enero para cobertura que comienza el 1 de enero de 2027. ARHOME (Medicaid de Arkansas) permanece abierto todo el ano en cualquier momento si su ingreso califica. ARKids First para ninos tambien esta disponible todo el ano. Si ocurre otro evento calificador de vida durante la brecha, como mudarse dentro de Arkansas, tener un bebe o casarse, ese evento reinicia una nueva ventana SEP de 60 dias.

es.question: Que reglas especificas de Arkansas aplican al seguro medico despues de perder el trabajo?
es.answer: Arkansas usa healthcare.gov para la inscripcion en el Mercado, no un intercambio estatal separado. ARHOME (Medicaid de Arkansas) es administrado por el Departamento de Servicios Humanos de Arkansas y cubre adultos al 138% FPL a traves de la expansion del ACA. ARKids First cubre a ninos hasta los 19 anos aproximadamente al 211% FPL. Arkansas no tiene ley mini-COBRA estatal para empleadores con menos de 20 empleados. Solicite ARHOME en access.arkansas.gov o llame al 1-855-372-1084. Para planes del Mercado, solicite en healthcare.gov y seleccione su condado de Arkansas para ver los planes disponibles.

es.question: Que pasa con la cobertura de mis hijos despues de perder mi trabajo en Arkansas?
es.answer: ARKids First (CHIP de Arkansas) cubre a ninos menores de 19 anos en hogares hasta aproximadamente el 211% FPL (alrededor de $69,630 para una familia de cuatro en 2026). ARKids First A es gratuito para hogares dentro de los limites de ingresos de ARHOME. ARKids First B cubre a ninos en hogares de ingresos mas altos a primas muy bajas. La inscripcion en ARKids First es todo el ano sin fecha limite de 60 dias. Incluso si sus propios ingresos son demasiado altos para ARHOME despues de la perdida del trabajo, sus hijos pueden aun calificar para ARKids First B de forma independiente. Solicite en access.arkansas.gov o a traves de healthcare.gov.
